personality_one_liner: A bold, friendly, and welcoming golf community that feels tactile, social, and deeply connected to the course.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Chunky cards with oversized tap areas. Cards never flush to screen edge; always at least md margin. Controlled asymmetry and floating playful modules.

do's: Bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Floating action buttons or primary CTA floating containers
Featured cards with frosted glass overlay on background photos

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Welcoming entry point for golfers to sign up or log in.

states.error: Readable inline form errors or toast for failed login.

screens.layout: Hero image covering the top 40% with a vertical gradient scrim fading into surface color at the bottom. Playful, chunky inputs with soft borders. Large pill-shaped primary button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Activity feed of rounds, photos, and comments from fellow golfers.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty golf green with text 'No rounds yet. Follow friends or go play!' and a primary CTA to discover.

screens.layout: Scrollable list of thick, tactile cards. Each card displays user info, course name, total score, an attached photo (with bottom gradient scrim and overlayed score data), and action buttons (like, comment). Glass header.

screens.name: Log Round
screens.purpose: Form to input scorecard details, course info, notes, and photos.

states.loading: Spinner centered over the form while saving.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable layout with large form inputs. A section for attaching photos with image previews. Sticky 'Save Round' CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView with safe-area bottom padding. This screen must support receiving initial params via Share Intent (course name, score array, etc.).

screens.name: Post Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a round with full scorecard stats and comment thread.

states.empty: No comments yet message in comment list.
states.error: Failed to load post message with retry.

screens.layout: Hero image from the post at top, stats layered below in pill modules. A distinct, visually structured scorecard summary (grid). Bottom area features a scrolling comment thread with a fixed bottom input bar for adding comments.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: Displays golfer stats, handicap, and their round history.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for stats and feed.
states.empty: Zero rounds played message with an illustration.

screens.layout: Profile cover image with gradient scrim and avatar slightly overlapping the content below (asymmetrical tactile feel). Bold typography for Handicap and Total Rounds. Horizontal scroll for recent courses, vertical list for past rounds.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Search and explore new courses and golfers to follow.

states.empty: Type to search courses and golfers.

screens.layout: Sticky glass search bar at top. Segmented control (pill style) to switch between 'Golfers' and 'Courses'. Results are chunky rows with initials/avatars or course photo thumbnails (with brandTertiary tint containers).

auth_hero.alt: Friends playing golf and smiling on a sunny day

empty_feed.alt: Empty golf green with red flag at sunset

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT' personality tightly. Avoid flat lists; instead, use chunky, soft-rounded cards (radius lg or pill), thick tap areas (min 44pt), and playful layout grouping (like stacked or asymmetric modules).
Ensure 'Log Round' screen acts as a potential target for the Share Intent handler. It must accept pre-filled params seamlessly via navigation route params or deep link payload.

For all images that feature text overlay (e.g. photos attached to a round on the Home feed, or Profile banners), mandate a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text legibility.
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers. Verify that scrolling content underneath remains legible but abstracted.
Do not use generic blue colors anywhere in the app. Strict reliance on the provided golf-inspired warm off-white and fairway green palette.
Include tactile haptic feedback on major actions: Save Round, Like Post, Tab Switches, and Form Submissions.
Do NOT use any emojis in the system UI.
Avoid standard unstyled React Native components; wrap inputs, cards, and buttons with the tactile styling system (e.g., shadow tier 2, Pill shapes, clear foreground/background layering).
